query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE reason
                    WHEN 'purchase'        THEN quantity
                    WHEN 'return'          THEN quantity
                    WHEN 'adjustment'      THEN quantity
                    WHEN 'sale'            THEN -quantity
                    WHEN 'purchase_return' THEN -quantity
                    WHEN 'loss'            THEN -quantity
                END
            ), 0) AS "stock!"
            FROM stock_movements
            WHERE product_id = $1
